English.Char_Desc_2000: Know your drivers before you change them. Tweaky Driver by Aurelio Avila brings Windows 10/11 x64 device inventory, installed versions and available driver offers into one review workflow. Inspect package sources and metadata before downloading. Download-ready offers and catalog candidates are distinct; some packages are download-only, and installation remains a separate reviewed step. Free includes one complete scan of supported sources every 10 days. The drivers found by that scan remain available to download and install until the next free scan unlocks. Device inventory and read-only diagnostics remain available. A free account with a verified email is required. Optional paid Pro adds unlimited scans, downloads and supported installations, saved jobs and offline kits. Check the official product page for current prices, eligibility and renewal terms. Driver detection does not establish compatibility or guarantee a performance improvement. Universal hardware coverage is not promised. The screenshot was captured on November 3, 2026 from the actual 0.1.44 frontend with fictional sample data, visibly labelled in the image. No real device scan, download or installation was performed for it. The version-specific official setup is digitally signed by Aurelio Avila and includes a trusted timestamp. Signing identifies the publisher and protects integrity; it does not guarantee the absence of SmartScreen warnings or software defects. This is proprietary freemium software, not open source.
